FN-RB5VBYM-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 253
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/31/2025
Senate Bill 253 as introduced could increase or decrease receipts to the Alabama Massage
Therapy Licensing Board Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the differences in
the fee schedule amounts set out in current law and any new amounts that would be established
by the board rule. In addition, this bill could further increase receipts to the Alabama Massage
Therapy Licensing Board Fund from the $1,000 per day fine established by the provisions of
this bill.
Page 1

FN-RB5VBYM-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 253
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/28/2025
Senate Bill 253 as passed the Senate could increase or decrease receipts to the Alabama
Massage Therapy Licensing Board Fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the
difference in collections pursuant to the existing fee schedule set in current law and any new
amounts that would be established by the board rule pursuant to this bill. In addition, this bill
could further increase receipts to the fund by $1,000 per day for fines established by the
provisions of this bill.
This bill would also remove the prohibition that the board's expenditures may not exceed the
revenues of the board for a fiscal year.
